title: Read comfortably
summary: Adjust the appearance and move through documentation with your keyboard.
benefit: Read the instructions in a way that suits your screen.
outcome: You can change the theme, enlarge the text and navigate without a mouse.

sections.title: Choose an appearance
paragraphs: Use the Appearance selector in the documentation header. Choose Light, Dark or System. System follows your device's appearance.
Your choice is remembered in this browser when storage is available. The app uses the same appearance preference. If the browser blocks storage, the selection still works for the current page.

sections.title: Use your keyboard
paragraphs: Press Tab to move between links and controls. A visible outline marks your current position. The first link, Skip to content, takes you past the header and guide list.

Press Enter to follow a link. On a small screen, open Browse guides with Enter or Space; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button. The guide list is part of the page, so Tab can continue into the article.
On a Mac in Safari, Option–Tab includes links in keyboard navigation. Safari’s Advanced settings can also make Tab include every page item.

sections.title: Make room for the text
paragraphs: Use your browser's zoom controls to enlarge the page. On narrow screens the guide list moves behind Browse guides, and the article stays in one column.
Screenshots support the written steps. Their captions explain what each image demonstrates; you can follow the instructions from the text as well.

sections.title: Return to a section
paragraphs: Use On this page to jump to a heading. The address keeps the section anchor, so you can bookmark it or open it again later.
